newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express January load factor slips.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express January load factor slips.

text.p: Midwest Express Holdings Inc said Tuesday its passenger load factor in January for its Midwest Express Airlines fell 3.3 points to 53.2 percent from 56.5 percent in January of 1996.
The carrier said revenue passenger miles increased to 93.0 million from 85.7 million, while available seat miles rose to 175.0 million from 151.5 million in January.
The company said the decrease in load factor was a direct result of new flights added in May and September.

Midwest Express said the passenger load factor for its Skyway unit last month slid to 37.3 percent from 38.2 percent. Skyway's revenue passenger miles were 4.9 milion, compared to 4.9 million one year ago, while Skyway's available seat miles increased slightly to 13.1 million from 13.0 million.
Midwest Express offers flights to business travelers to 22 cities, while Skyway operates in 25 cities.
Its shares were unchanged Tuesday at 37-1/4.
